ONLY this rally application provides real-time stage results and comprehensive statistics of rally racing teams. Never miss any race results from your favourite rally team again! You can download it for free now!

Features:
+ rally event selection and stage selection
+ after stage and over-all rally event results
+ graph results (position, time differential)
+ LIVE race info and news
+ guide with rally stage maps and spectator places
+ championship standing
+ media content with report videos and on-board camera
+ navigation around rally tracks and POIs. Works with free navigation application Waze

Currently supported Championships:
+ CZ - Mistrovství ČR v Rally, Rallysprint série
+ SK - Majstrovstvá Slovenska v rally
+ PT - CNR, TNRA
+ WRC, ERC
